sources.note: Nothing. Section 'Phonology' infers 8 consonants (m n p t k ʔ β ɾ) and 5-6 vowels plus two diphthongs from 'Vincent (n.d.) 97 terms for Kambaira'; discusses sound changes shared with North Tairora and Binumarien loans; no word for stress, accent, tone or pitch anywhere on the page. States 'Nothing is known about Kambaira verbal morphology.' Population 135 (1959-60) after Wurm & Laycock 1961: 139.
